verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Firebase Security Rules for data access policy and general auth, but no documentation of issuing scoped/least-privilege API credentials specifically for an AI agent; in fact, a community note indicates Firebase API keys are 'public by design' rather than issued with fine-grained per-agent scopes. missing for 10: any first-party mechanism to mint scoped, agent-specific credentials, evidence of least-privilege key/token issuance, and confirmation the MCP server or CLI supports restricted-scope auth for agents.
